title: What happens after you answer a card
body: Your answer is posted once and the card locks.

nodes.label: Card
nodes.detail: You pick an option and press send.

nodes.label: Webhook
nodes.detail: The answer is posted as JSON.

nodes.label: Agent
nodes.detail: The agent reads it and continues.

nodes.label: Confirmation
nodes.detail: The agent confirms receipt in chat.

reveal.label: What if sending fails?
reveal.body: The card shows an error and stays editable, so you can retry without losing your answer.
